    [SHEET 04.D] · LIMIT

    A lens, not a law

    The model is built on six Anglo-American saecula: one region, a small sample. The files also record the charge that it breeds fatalism, can provoke the crisis it predicts, and has been taken up for partisan ends.

    The repository’s revised model treats cycles as heuristic metaphors, not clocks. The dates after 2008 are therefore a forecast. [REV 1 · OPEN] Read the pattern as a way to ask questions, not a timetable.
